title: Rekucci Women's Classic Chic Shift Dress
description: Rekucci presents this shift_dress designed for womens adult. Made from polyester and spandex, it features a back invisible zipper, fully-lined body, unlined sleeves, 3/4 length sleeves, flattering boat neck, and front bust darts. Perfect for dining, work, and casual occasions.
aboutThisItem: CLASSIIC CHIC: This silky smooth jersey knit dress is a classic confortable, soft touching dress for any occasions. From church to work, cocktail to holiday, you will be forever chic.
FEATURES: Back invisible zipper. Fully-lined body, unlined sleeves. 3/4 length sleeves. Flattering, beautiful boat neck. Front bust darts help to give a curve-contouring fit.
SIZING DETAILS: Semi-fitted style skims the body without being tight. Knee length style. Front length from shoulder to hem=38" based on size 6. Model is 5'9" wearing dress size 4.
DRESSY KNIT: Silky smooth jersey knit 95% Polyester, 5% Spandex. *Contents may vary. Placement prints create a slimming effect.
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Easy care: Machine wash, cold water. Hang or lay flat to dry. Made in Indonesia or Vietnam. Fabric resists wrinkling so it's also great for packing and travel
